summary: Implemented the Version 0.1 group collaboration layer for students and local AI coding agents using a shared Git repository.
completed_work: Implemented group initialization, configuration validation, member validation, and structured event creation.
Implemented remote event discovery, event validation, immutability checking, and local discovery checkpoints.
Documented procedures for SYNC, PUB, INT, REV, TEST, STATUS, and FINAL.
Implemented final-candidate generation and finalization with explicit human confirmation.
Added automated tests for event handling, remote discovery, validation, and finalization.
Demonstrated three simulated members publishing changes, discovering events, integrating code, resolving a deliberate conflict, and testing the combined result.
test_evidence: Canonical commit 6870c9379090bd4794536a8eb905c9e2e33d45f0: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v - 27 tests passed.
python groupctl.py validate: group configuration, event records, and members validated before candidate preparation.
python scripts/run_three_member_demo.py: DEMO SUCCESS in a temporary local Git remote. Live GitHub collaboration and independently operated AI agents remain untested.
known_limitations: The three-member demonstration uses simulated members and a temporary local Git remote. Collaboration among independently operated AI agents and actual GitHub permission handling still needs to be demonstrated.
